info.name: Renivet Backend - OTP Verification and Account Recovery (REN2-22/23)
info.description: Version-controlled verification and password recovery workflows. Synthetic examples only; in-memory fake delivery runs only in disposable CI. No Postman Cloud sync. Linear: REN2-22/23.

item.name: 01 — Identity & Authentication — OTP Challenges
item.description: Public, unauthenticated email/phone verification. No permission or bearer token is required. Successful verification consumes the challenge and verifies only its bound contact. Linear: REN2-22.

request.description: Purpose: request a short-lived six-digit email verification challenge. Linear: REN2-22. Parameters: none. Body: channel=email, purpose=email_verification, destination=synthetic email. Authentication/permissions: public, none. Responses: 202 accepted (neutral for unknown/already-verified contacts and transient delivery failures after challenge invalidation); 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when proof configuration or the globally configured provider is unavailable; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. Example uses synthetic data.

exec: pm.test('challenge request is neutral 202', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('accepted'); pm.expect(body.challengeId).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); pm.collectionVariables.set('otpChallengeId', body.challengeId); });

request.description: Purpose: consume a correct, unexpired email verification challenge. Linear: REN2-22. Parameters: challengeId UUID path parameter. Body: email_verification purpose and six-digit synthetic code. Authentication/permissions: public, none. Responses: 200 verified; 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR. The disposable test adapter uses only synthetic data.

exec: pm.test('correct proof verifies once', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'verified' }); });

request.description: Negative authorization/state example: an unknown challenge is denied with the same generic response used for expired, wrong-purpose, exhausted, wrong-code and replayed challenges. Linear: REN2-22. Parameters: synthetic UUID. Body: synthetic wrong code. Authentication/permissions: public, none. Expected: 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; no contact, code or account state is returned.

exec: pm.test('unknown proof gets generic denial', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTHENTICATION_FAILED'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('buyer@example.test'); });

request.description: Negative validation example: channel and purpose must be a matching pair. Linear: REN2-22. Body uses only synthetic data. Authentication/permissions: public, none. Expected: 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID.

exec: pm.test('mismatched channel and purpose are rejected safely', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTH_INPUT_INVALID'); });

item.name: Unknown email gets same neutral recovery response (REN2-23)

request.description: Negative enumeration test. Linear: REN2-23. Body uses a synthetic unknown email. Authentication/permissions: public. Expected neutral 202 with the same status and fields as an eligible account; the opaque challenge is unusable.

exec: pm.test('unknown recovery identity receives a neutral accepted shape', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('accepted'); pm.collectionVariables.set('recoveryNeutralShape', Object.keys(pm.response.json()).sort().join(',')); });

request.description: Purpose: request neutral email password recovery. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters: none. Body: channel=email, purpose=password_recovery, synthetic email. Authentication/permissions: public; eligible account must have verified email and active password. Responses: 202 accepted regardless of account eligibility; 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR.

exec: pm.test('known recovery identity receives the same neutral accepted shape', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('accepted'); pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json()).sort().join(',')).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('recoveryNeutralShape')); pm.collectionVariables.set('recoveryChallengeId', pm.response.json().challengeId); });

request.description: Negative validation case. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters: challengeId UUID. Body has the synthetic valid recovery code and an invalid replacement passphrase. Authentication/permissions: public challenge proof. Expected: 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; challenge remains available for a corrected password.

exec: pm.test('invalid recovery passphrase is rejected without consuming proof', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTH_INPUT_INVALID'); });

item.name: Consume recovery proof, replace password and revoke sessions (REN2-23)

request.description: Purpose: consume purpose-bound proof and atomically replace the Argon2id password and revoke prior sessions. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters: challengeId UUID. Body: synthetic six-digit recovery code and new passphrase. Authentication/permissions: public challenge-bound proof. Responses: 200 verified; 400 AUTH_INPUT_INVALID; 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED for invalid, expired, wrong-purpose or replayed proof; 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED; 503 AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; 500 AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR.

exec: pm.test('recovery proof resets password and returns no secret', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({status:'verified'}); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.environment.get('recoveryPassword')); });

request.description: Negative replay test: a consumed recovery proof must not reset credentials again. Linear: REN2-23. Parameters: synthetic challenge UUID. Body: synthetic recovery proof. Authentication/permissions: public challenge-bound proof. Expected: 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.

exec: pm.test('consumed recovery proof cannot be replayed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('AUTHENTICATION_FAILED'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.environment.get('recoveryPassword')); });
